caption: The drawing depicts a geometric and symmetrical textile pattern. The upper section features zigzag chevrons in layered rows, using shades of beige, brown, dark brown, and navy blue, highlighted with clusters of small orange floral motifs. Near the top, there are scalloped edges with green and blue tones, forming a border. Centralized within the brown sections are circular pixel-like motifs that transition from cream to brown and orange, positioned symmetrically. Below the chevrons, the background transitions to a mint green color containing a series of cross-shaped motifs in brown, beige, and off-white, arranged in an orderly horizontal row. The bottom section of the pattern mirrors the top's scalloped border, incorporating the same color palette of green, dark brown, gray, and orange within the stepped geometric design. The entire pattern is composed of square and rectangular sections filled with consistent colors, creating a distinctive woven, tiled effect. The drawing is framed by a thin, off-white border.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
